tei:div.tei:p: dpal ldan lha mo'i phrin las gsang ba'i byang bu rdo rje'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/

rgyal kun thugs kyi gter gcig pu// rdo rje 'dzin pa khro bo'i rgyal// gsang ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal te// ma mo gsang ba'i byang bu 'god// hūm̐/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i nam mkha' la// 'thor byed rlung nag tshogs kyi rgya gram gtams// chags pa rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khyil// zhing chen gtams pa'i sa gzhi mtha' dbus brdal// keng rus 'bar ba'i ri rab gzhal yas ni// chu srin bye ba sa ya thod pa la// mi bzad dur khrod 'bar ba'i rtsig rmang byas// thod dgu 'bar ba'i rtsig pa mkhar du byas// gnam lcags ngar mo 'bar ba'i gzer chen btab// rin chen mchog gi gru bzhi mdzes par byas// g.yu 'od sngon po 'bar ba'i kha bad can// mu khyud gnam lcags 'bar ba'i me ris bskor// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas 'dir// zhing chen zhing chung mang po gcal du bkram// mchog chen mchog phran mang po gdan du bting*// the'u rang dgu brgya mang po'i gab rtse la// lha srin sde brgyad mang po'i nang rten cing*// dur khrod dbyings nas phyag rgya'i skur gsal ba// mdog bzang nag mo ral ba'i dbu rgyan can// rgyan dang cha lugs sna tshogs 'jigs pas bskor// 'tshub ma'i nang na sku yi phyag rgya gsal// snang zhing srid pa thams cad ma mor bsgom// ma mo rnam dag byang chub sems su gsal// sems nyid lhun grub ye nas sangs rgyas bsgom// hūm̐// dpal ldan lha mo 'gro kun byams ma khyed// sems can la ni byams mgon ma dang 'dra// mi bslu dam tshig rjes su dgongs mdzod la// bdag la brtser dgongs gnas 'dir myur du byon// sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka'i// spyan sngar khas blang dam bcas pa'i// ma ru tse yi sgo 'gram du// khas blang mna' bor dran gyis la// dam tshig bzhin du gshegs su gsol// hūm̐// ma g.yel ma g.yel thugs dam can// ma g.yel ma g.yel srung ma'i tshogs// kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi yum// ma mo 'bod pa'i glu len zhing*// sgra ni stong khams khyab par sgrogs// sgrub ni ye shes thig ler bsgrub// brten ni he ru'i gnas su brten// dur khrod chen po'i gnas 'di ru// sha chen gsur gyi dri snom zhing*// maṃ sa chen po ri ltar spungs// rak+ta'i rgya mtsho mtsho ltar bskyil// rus pa'i phung po ri rab spungs// dri chu mang po chu ltar 'brub// ru dar dmar nag le brgan dar// rma bya'i rgyal mtshan mthing nag gur// snel mo'i mgo dang g.yang gzhi snying*// nal bu'i rgyal mtshan sha khrag dang*// tsit+ta'i rgyal mtshan lug nag gsob// ltag sprod rnga dang phreng chen rnams// ma mo brten pa'i rdzas su 'bul// bskang rdzas sna tshogs 'bras bu dang*// sman sna stong dang sha sna stong*// khrag sna stong dang chu sna stong*// bya nag lug nag khyi rog mo// tsa ra zal le nag po'i mdangs// mi khyi rta yi bam gyis bskor// ma mo khyod la mchod pa 'bul// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// yul drug dbang drug rnam shes drug

/khams dang skye mched bcas pa rnams// malus bzhes nas bsnam du gsol// kyai/ yongs 'dus shing gi gnas mchog nas// rin chen mdzes pa'i pho brang nas// bde ldan 'phrul gyi lding khang na// 'gying bag tshul du bzhugs pa ni// dbang phyug sras mo ma lags sam// dga' byed dung skyong ma lags sam// dbyar bzhin nam mkha'i khams la rgyu// 'brug dang glog gi bdag mo mdzad// lce dang bu yug 'bebs mdzad ma// glog ma sprin gyis mchod pa bzhes// dpyid bzhin kun la drod 'bebs ma// chu bo kun gyi sna 'dren ma// chu bo kun gyi gzhung 'byams ma// nag mo'i gtso mos mchod pa bzhes// ston bzhin 'bras bu smin mdzad ma// spang po de ni kha ser la// 'bru dang lo yi bcud len ma// mi rnams kun gyi dpal 'phrog ma// rdo rje glog 'gyus mchod pa bzhes// dgun bzhin rgya mtsho gting na bzhugs// khams gsum kun gyi rgyas 'debs ma// klu phran kun gyi dgyes sde mo// ka li nag mos mchod pa bzhes// rdo rje dri chu bdud rtsi mchog /pañtsa a mri ta dang sbyar// dam rdzas snying gi khrag chen po// bsre ba'i mchog ste srog gi snying*// 'jigs pa'i rgyal mo bzhes su gsol// mi zad rgya mtsho bzhes su gsaul// rkang drug mdzes ma bzhes su gsol// mdog bzang nag mo bzhes su gsol// ma gcig 'dir byon sha la rol// 'byung po'i sha ni zan bas zhim// 'byung po'i khrag ni chang bas zhim// 'byung po'i rus pa mar bas bzhun// 'dir spyon sha khrag rus pa bzhes// brnag pa'i las 'di mthar phyung la// da lta rtags dang mtshan ma phyung*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kun// bde chen chos kyi dbyings su gso// phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kun// snying po byang chub sems su gso// thugs rje byams pa'i chu rgyun gyis// khams gsum sems can nyon mongs gso// 'du ba'i nad kyis zin pa rnams// bdud rtsi chen po sman gyis gso// thugs rjes rgyun thag chad pa rnams// rang byung ye shes chen pos gso// dam tshig rgyun thag chad pa rnams// mi brjed gzungs kyi thugs rjes gso// shes rab snang ba 'gags pa na// ting 'dzin ma yengs brtan pos gso// shes rab me lce chad pa nas// rtogs pa'i khyad par brtan pos gso// rang byung ye shes rgyun chad pa// snying po byang chub sems kyis gso// sems kyi de nyid ma rtogs pa// shes rab ting 'dzin brtan pos gso// ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa rnams// snying po byang chub sems kyis gso// khyed la mthol bshags gsol ba ni// rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa pos// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// mtshams med lnga dang mi dge bcu// mdor na sdig pa ci mchis pa// de dag bdag gis so so bshags//

yig brgya brjod/ hūm̐/ ma g.yel ma 'da' sring gcig ma// ma yi nang nas ma gcig ma// dam nyams kun gyi bdud gcod ma// re ma ti la phyag 'tshal bstod// dam las gnas pa'i tshe 'dzin ma// stong gsum kun gyi nyul le ma// nad dang rims kyi bdag mo mdzad// lha mo dung skyong ma la bstod// chibs su drel rta rkang gsum chibs// drwa ba dgu yi steng len can// bye ru dmar po'i rgyan srab can// 'byung po'i rje mau khyod la bstod// nyin bzhin khyod dgu skung du sbed// mtshan mo dur khrod khyab par nyul// rnal 'byor tshogs khang mtha' dag 'grim// dbang phyug chen mo khyod la bstod// khyod kyi lag pa g.yas pa na// bdud kyi khram bam re re thogs// skye 'gro dbugs su snang ba kun// sang phod deng sang su 'chi ba// do cig shwa rdel nag po 'grems// rdo rje mkha' 'gro khyod la bstod// khyod ni mchan khung g.yas pa na// byang dmar dkyus kyi bam so sbed// sang phod deng sang su 'chi ba// do cig byang dmar dkyus la 'debs// lha min g.yul bzlog khyed la bstod// khyod kyi mchan khung g.yon pa na// nad kyi rkyal pa sngo dmar la// sbrul nag lnga brgya'i kha chings can// lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// gsang sngags bon du gyer ba'i dus// rnal 'byor grong bsnyen byed pa'i dus// de tshe srid pa'i ma mo 'khrugs// khyod kyi kha rlangs ser po yi// steng khams thams cad 'gengs byed cing*// bud med ser mos sa gzhi 'gengs// phung byed chen po khyed la bstod// nam mkha'i mthongs na khyod gnas pa// nam mkha'i dbyings phyug dpa' mo btsan// sems can kun gyi lam ston ma// ri khrod lha mo khyod la bstod// bar snang khams na bzhugs pa'i tshe// bha ga hristi mkha' la char 'beb ma// 'byung ba lnga yi cha snyoms ma// 'dzam bu gling gi bcud len ma// mi pham khro gnyer khyod la bstod// ri rab zom la bzhugs pa'i tshe// me za ma la brag gyon ma// su tra kun gyi tshe 'dzin ma// dung skyong dkar mo khyod la bstod// 'bar ma nyul byed gtso mo ni// 'bar ma nyi ma'i zhags pa can// phud lhag nyul zhing bsgrub mchog skyong*// 'dod khams dbang phyug khyed la bstod// dbang phyug gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe// mi srun g.yag mgo thod rlon can// kha chu snyegs shing sgrub mchog skyong*// dbang skur mchog thob khyod la bstod// ma brgyad gtso bo mdzad pa'i tshe// e ka tsa ṭi ral gcig ma// rnal 'byor ting 'dzin drod nyul ma// dus gsum bdag mo khyod la bstod// mkha' 'gro lha mo re ma ti// bskal pa mang po'i sngon rol nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhal mthong zhing*// dman pa'i zhing 'dir sprul pa'i sku// lha mo'i tshul du sku bstan pa// 'gro ba'i don la rab tu brtson// nyon mongs sgrib pa rab tu spang*// da lta shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyong*// sems ma chen mo khyed la bstod// 'di nas phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe// mkha' 'gro lha mo nag mo khyod// byang shar mtshams kyi 'jig rten khams// pad mo rnam par rol ba der// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// pad mos dpal zhes sangs rgyas pa'i// lung bstan thob la phyag 'tshal lo// de yi khol mo re ma ti// da lta sgom pa'i lam na gnas// ma 'ongs pad ma'i zhing khams der// byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni// blo gros bshes gnyen gyur la bstod// de ltar bskang zhing gsol ba'i mthus// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis// rnam bzhi'i las kyi phrin las kun// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod//
ces snyigs ma'i byed spyod mi rung bas ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa'i rims yams zhi bar dmigs te chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris pa dge'o/// /
